shell_commands: npx prettier --write src/transport/wsTestUtils.ts && npx eslint src/transport/wsTestUtils.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1
grep -n "it('answers list_sessions for the authenticated\|it('answers an empty session_list\|it('accepts a bare list_sessions" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
npx eslint src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/wsTestUtils.ts 2>&1 && echo "✓ ESLint passed"

git add src/transport/wsTestUtils.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && git rm src/types/messages.list-sessions.test.ts

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: extract shared test utilities and fix linting errors

- Extract common WebSocket test utilities into wsTestUtils.ts (eventually,
  startEngineWithStore, askAfterConnect, delegatingTo) to eliminate code
  duplication between conversationList and sessionResume tests
- Fix no-nested-if linting issue by removing unnecessary conditional nesting
- Update conversationList tests to use shared utilities
- Import delegatingTo in sessionResume.test.ts instead of defining locally
- Remove non-functional test file (messages.list-sessions.test.ts) that was
  only testing type imports without exercising production code
- Update spec.md line number references in conversation-list spec to match
  refactored test file locations
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
timeout 30 npx vitest run src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -50

git add src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(transport): validate bare list_sessions frame

Add validation support for list_sessions messages. Accepts a bare
{type: 'list_sessions'} frame with no optional fields.

- Add 'list_sessions' case to validateMessage switch
- Implement validateListSessionsMessage to accept bare frames
- Test validates the minimal valid list_sessions payload

This is the first step toward full list_sessions validation,
which will expand to handle optional limit and before fields.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status
git add .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "chore: update dod.md with progress on list_sessions validation" && git push origin HEAD
